messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
我們提供以下幾種材質供您選擇：

| 材質 | 特點 |
|------|------|
| 青銅（Bronze） | 耐久、光澤感強，適合戶外或室內展示 |
| 大理石（Marble） | 高雅、重量感十足，適合正式場合 |
| 瓦土（Terracotta） | 自然風格、溫暖色調，適合庭院或休閒空間 |
| 木材（Wood） | 溫馨、可做多樣表面處理，適合家庭環境 |
| 石材（Stone） | 堅固、自然紋理，適合大型公共藝術 |

請問您對哪一種材質比較感興趣？如果已決定，我可以協助您下單並指定尺寸（預設為 12 英吋）。
message.reasoning: User wants to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask what materials options? Actually they want to order a custom sculpture with their preferred material. They want to know what materials choices exist. The tool has sculpture_create_custom with item, material (Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone), size optional default 12. So we can call the function with item="horse", material=some choice. But user didn't specify which material. They just asked "有哪些材料選擇?" That means "What material options are available?" We could respond with list of options. But maybe we should ask them to choose. But the instruction says "When you need to use a function, you must do so." But we don't need to call function unless they request an order. They only ask about material options. So we can answer without calling function. But we might also mention that we have Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. Then ask if they'd like to place an order. Let's comply.
